identity.jq: ([.[]][0] // {}) as $r | {signedIn: ((($r.key // "") | length > 0) or (($r.refresh_token // "") | length > 0)), email: ($r.email // ""), plan: "", expiresAt: null, expired: (($r.expires_at // null) as $e | if $e and (($r.refresh_token // "") == "") then (try (($e | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdate) * 1000 < $now) catch false) else false end)}

localUsage.note: Grok publishes no limits; usage is estimated from its local session index.
